checks: Status checks real EVM deployment and linked registry
Legacy or incompatible opening policies fail readiness
Tender endpoint decodes real Solidity tuple and filters restricted fields
Approved and unapproved wallets reflect real registry roles
Role revocation is visible on the next read
An address without deployed code is rejected
A registry from a different deployment is rejected
RPC failures are sanitized and health stays available
An unresponsive provider is bounded by the configured timeout
execution: Real isolated Hardhat EVM; HTTP handler injection without a listening TCP socket
limitations: Does not test an OS TCP listener or the user's existing localhost node
No authentication, transaction signing or production deployment
